## What changed

Describe the behavior and link the related issue or discussion.

## Verification

List the checks you ran. For Android/SMS behavior, include the tested device and OS, or explain why device testing was not possible. Use synthetic data only.

## Review notes

Call out protocol, authentication, privacy, billing, migration, or deployment effects. Include screenshots for UI changes when useful.

- [ ] My commits have `Signed-off-by:` lines (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private data, real phone numbers, and message bodies from the diff and logs.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible behavior.
